decisions.reason: Premise was a voluntary daily-allowance insurance; Art. 324b OR only covers insurance that is obligatory by law (a voluntary one falls under Art. 324a para. 4 OR, which states no 4/5 rule). DE asked for a daily amount but the answer is monthly; FR/IT differed. Rewritten as an Art. 324b scenario, monthly amount in all three languages.

decisions.reason: AHV 21 transitional provisions: women born 1961-1963 may still draw the pension from 62, so the near miss '62' was correct for them. Question restricted to persons born in 1964 or later; near misses 62 and 64 (both in the version of 2023-09-01) removed, 65 (reference age) added.
